evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: In a ten-domain enterprise collection, a task's evidence is spread across a source document of median length 27 pages (mean 48.8, maximum 873); a third of tasks rest mainly on charts, drawings, and maps; and 70.9% require two or more reasoning hops.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We argue that long-context evaluation of agents should report accuracy jointly with tokens and turns, and that datasets of long documents should ship text and image renderings alongside each PDF.

declaredVenue: Accepted at the Third Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM) at NeurIPS 2026. 14 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables
